JSON to Go Struct

Convert JSON to Go structs with json tags — nested structs, slices and omitempty included.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your JSON sample.
  2. Set the root struct name.
  3. Click Generate to build the structs.
  4. Copy the code or download types.go.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are nested objects handled?

Each nested object becomes its own named struct, referenced by the parent field.

What do the struct tags look like?

Every field gets a `json:"key"` tag; nullable fields also get `,omitempty`.

How are arrays typed?

As slices — []string, []int, or []NestedStruct. Mixed or empty arrays become []interface{}.

Does the output compile?

Yes — paste it into any Go file. No imports are needed unless you add time.Time fields yourself.
